entities.name: Thran Alliance
entities.description: Alliance of enemies of Yawgmoth and Thran city-states that won the Thran Civil War.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Took control of parts of the Thran Empire; bombarded cities and sent people to Phyrexia.

entities.name: Thran Civil War
entities.description: War won by the Alliance at great cost.

entities.name: Gulatto Meisha
entities.description: Home of barbaric humans in the Alliance.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: Where people were forced to join Yawgmoth and were twisted into minions.

events.summary: Yawgmoth's enemies and opposing Thran city-states form an alliance against him.
The Alliance wins the Thran Civil War, though Yawgmoth bombarded cities and many thousands were killed or forced into Phyrexia.
events.quote: The Alliance won the following Thran Civil War
